input_fields.name: viewport
input_fields.description: Maximized unobstructed viewport and empty drag region.

input_fields.name: drag_path
input_fields.description: One short zoom drag path and declared direction.

input_fields.name: navigation_mapping
input_fields.description: Verified Ctrl+middle-drag Zoom mapping or Zoom-tool equivalent.

result_fields.name: zoomed_view
result_fields.description: Before/after apparent scale, camera orientation, drag/control path, and geometry-unchanged observation.

procedure: Place the cursor in empty viewport space and check modifier/middle-button support.
Use one short calibrated Ctrl+middle drag, or activate Zoom and use one ordinary left drag as the recorded equivalent.
Observe apparent scale change and unchanged model geometry/orientation, then return zoomed_view.
If neither control is verifiable, stop with needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject selected geometry under the drag, uncalibrated mapping, unsupported Ctrl+middle drag without a Zoom equivalent, or no observable scale change.
Do not infer zoom from cursor motion alone.
